In real CPython v3.10.19, PyInterpreterState_Delete is in Python/pystate.c (not pylifecycle.c); its zapthreads call precedes HEAD_LOCK interpreter-list removal. The solution is a native lifecycle regression model implementing the requested invariant, not a fabricated full-CPython patch: head_mutex serializes candidate lookup/ref acquisition and unlink/deleting transition; atomic acquire CAS takes a save reference only while listed and not deleting; atomic acq_rel fetch_sub frees only when old==1. Real upstream reference SHA256: pystate-v3.10.19.c c8d272d6274e5bd1e2ad79df908f26cbb48c3c5b048bf0631d2bbe44cce2beb9. Legacy deterministic lifetime model exits 2 when SaveThread would dereference an already-freed candidate. GCC ASan was attempted for fixed and legacy binaries but its allocator CHECK fails before main (sanitizer_allocator_primary64.h:131); no ASan result is claimed. The fixed evidence is UBSan plus explicit lifetime counters and deterministic/concurrent behavior. file_sha256_of_this_json is SHA-256 of the compact JSON preimage with this digest field empty.
